sql: UPDATE s.t SET name = 'new_name'
note: minimal UPDATE: SET single column with scalar literal

sql: UPDATE s.t SET name = 'multi', qty = 5, flag = true
note: SET multiple columns with comma-separated assignments

sql: UPDATE s.t SET val = NULL WHERE id = 1
note: SET column to NULL with WHERE clause filtering by primary key

sql: UPDATE s.t SET (name, qty) = ('tuple_name', 42)
note: SET column-list tuple syntax with row literal on RHS

sql: UPDATE s.t SET (name, qty) = (SELECT label, 99 FROM s.t2 LIMIT 1)
note: SET column-list tuple from subselect on RHS

sql: UPDATE s.t SET qty = DEFAULT
note: SET column to DEFAULT keyword (resets to column default)

sql: UPDATE s.t AS upd SET name = upd.name || '_sfx' WHERE upd.qty > 0
note: table alias in UPDATE with alias reference in SET expression and WHERE

sql: UPDATE s.t SET val = t2.amount FROM s.t2 WHERE s.t.id = s.t2.t_id
note: FROM clause joining secondary table; SET value from joined table

sql: UPDATE s.t SET qty = qty + 1 WHERE id IN (SELECT t_id FROM s.t2 WHERE amount > 0) RETURNING id, qty
note: subselect in WHERE + RETURNING clause

sql: UPDATE ONLY s.parent SET kind = 'base_only' WHERE id = 1
note: ONLY keyword restricts update to parent table, excluding child rows

sql: UPDATE s.t SET name = 'ret_all', qty = 0 RETURNING *
note: RETURNING * returns all columns of updated rows

sql: UPDATE s.t SET val = val * 1.1 WHERE flag = false RETURNING id, val AS new_val
note: RETURNING with expression alias

sql: UPDATE s.t SET name = (SELECT label FROM s.t2 WHERE s.t2.t_id = s.t.id LIMIT 1)
note: correlated subquery in SET expression

sql: UPDATE s.t2 SET amount = amount + s.t.val FROM s.t WHERE s.t.id = s.t2.t_id AND s.t.flag = true RETURNING s.t2.id, s.t2.amount
note: FROM with WHERE join condition, RETURNING columns from updated table

sql: UPDATE s.t SET name = 'a' WHERE id = 1; UPDATE s.t SET name = 'b' WHERE id = 2
note: two UPDATE statements sequentially in one case

sql: UPDATE s.t SET
note: syntax error: SET with no assignments

sql: UPDATE s.t name = 'missing_set'
note: syntax error: missing SET keyword

sql: UPDATE s.t SET name 'no_eq'
note: syntax error: missing = in SET assignment

sql: UPDATE s.t SET (name, qty) = (SELECT 'too_few' LIMIT 1)
note: error: column-list tuple subselect returns fewer columns than target list

sql: UPDATE s.t SET qty = qty + 1 RETURNING
note: syntax error: RETURNING with no output expressions
